title: A Phosphorylation-Induced Micellization Switch in the Low-Complexity Domain of TDP-43.
authors: Dillenburg, Rodrigo F; Lopatina, Anastasia; Ruan, Hao; Scheidt, Tom; Mosna, Simone; Pekbilir, Emre; Bieber, Julia; Schafer-Depoix, Frank; Landfester, Katharina; Schmidt, Carla; Mockel, Martin M; Morsbach, Svenja; Schmid, Friederike; Dormann, Dorothee; Stelzl, Lukas; Girard, Martin; Lemke, Edward A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过粗粒化蒙特卡洛模拟与实验结合，揭示TDP-43低复杂度域磷酸化诱导从相分离到有限尺寸胶束化的分子开关机制，直接聚焦IDR自组装互作机制建模，对无序蛋白PPI与凝聚体调控建模极具启发。
abstract: Phase separation (PS) of the low-complexity domain (LCD) of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 kDa (TDP-43) is linked to pathogenic aggregates in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD-TDP). Here, we show that extensive phosphorylation of the LCD C-terminus redirects its self-assembly. Coarse-grained Monte Carlo simulations predicted that 12 Ser phosphorylations partition the 148-residue LCD into a hydrophobic N-terminal and highly charged C-terminal block, favouring finite-sized micellization over macroscopic PS. In vitro, LCD phosphorylated by casein kinase 1 delta (CK1delta; mean of 12 phosphorylations by native mass spectrometry) and phosphomimetic 12D/12DD mutants formed spherical nanoparticles ( approximately  20-50 nm) above a low-micromolar critical micelle concentration, whereas the unphosphorylated LCD underwent reversible PS that matured into fibrils. Increasing ionic strength shifted the mutants toward anisotropic morphologies (wormlike 12D micelles and rigid 12DD nanocylinders). Turbidity assays and confocal imaging directly visualized the absence of PS in the phosphorylated form. Negative-stain and cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) confirmed the spherical micellar architecture for the phosphorylated LCD and 12D/12DD mimics. Our data identify phosphorylation as a molecular switch tuning macrophase separation and fibril formation of TDP-43 LCD, providing a framework for an aggregation-protective role through microphase separation into size-limited micelles. Whether these assemblies are stable or kinetically trapped on pathological timescales remains unclear.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）低复杂度结构域（LCD）的相分离（phase separation, PS）与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）和额颞叶变性（FTLD-TDP）中的致病性聚集体相关。在此，我们展示了LCD C末端广泛磷酸化会重定向其自组装。粗粒化蒙特卡洛模拟预测，12个丝氨酸磷酸化将148残基的LCD分隔为疏水性N末端和高度带电的C末端区块，有利于有限尺寸的胶束化而非宏观PS。在体外，由酪蛋白激酶1 delta（CK1delta；通过天然质谱法平均12个磷酸化）磷酸化的LCD以及磷酸模拟物12D/12DD突变体在低微摩尔临界胶束浓度以上形成球形纳米颗粒（约20-50 nm），而未磷酸化的LCD则经历可逆PS并成熟为纤维。增加离子强度使突变体转向各向异性形态（蠕虫状12D胶束和刚性12DD纳米圆柱体）。浊度测定和共聚焦成像直接可视化了磷酸化形式中PS的缺失。负染色和冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）确认了磷酸化LCD和12D/12DD模拟物的球形胶束结构。我们的数据将磷酸化识别为调节TDP-43 LCD宏观相分离和纤维形成的分子开关，为通过微相分离形成尺寸受限胶束的聚集保护作用提供了框架。这些组装体在病理时间尺度上是否稳定或动力学捕获仍不清楚。
